text_block_list.text:
One day shortly before the Sprinters Stakes.
Believe had been given her final rest day
before the real deal, but—
(Swish, swish, swish...)
As for Believe, she was by the sofa in the Trainer's Room, silently engrossed in what seemed to be her handicraft hobby, just as usual.
Even so, that scene in itself has become a familiar sight. That area over there is practically Believe's personal workspace at this point.

"That's why I don't overthink things either.
I just continue my work quietly on my end."
Before long, the sun would set, we'd exchange a brief parting word, and head on our separate ways home... That had been our daily routine for a while now, but...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

Just as I stretched, feeling a sense of relief...
she quietly spoke up.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Are you... done with work?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"...I think I'll go for a walk. Just a short one.
So—"

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: If you're alright with it... How about you have some too?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Trainer-san.
Sorry to keep you waiting.

And so, Believe and I began to walk.
—Feeling a slight sense of nostalgia.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...Um.
Well, I'll be going now.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
All you have to do is walk along with me.
—Are you really okay with that?

"Remembering those days before our contract.
Yet with a different state of mind than back then, I take a step forward."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Come to think of it, we talked about this when we went running the other day...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"Looks like I'll be able to get some plum syrup shared with me.
This time from Kunie-san."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Actually...
she went out of her way to prepare it for me.
choice_data_list: ...Well then, we'll have to make this toast count.
...Well then, we'll have to make this toast count.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...You're right.
So that we can toast to something truly meaningful.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
—Let us do work that leaves no regrets.
Without fail.

Quietly chatting about such things in soft murmurs,
I continued walking alongside Believe.
Before long, she suddenly stopped in her tracks.

It wasâa beautifully crafted church.
It had likely stood there for ages,
showing several signs of careful restoration.

And what Believe seemed to be paying
particular attention to was—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: This church has such beautiful stone steps.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"The walls on the way up... did you notice them?
Those are quite ancient stone walls... stone ramparts, actually."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: That's some fine uchikomi-hagi stonework.
choice_data_list: What kind of technique is that?
What kind of technique is that?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
This method involves crushing stone materials to flatten their surfaces before
stacking them up.
It allows us to build stone ramparts with minimal gaps.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Since hard stone must be processed,
it requires a considerable amount of time and effort.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"They're quite sturdy in exchange, though,
so we can stack them high—and above all..."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Built over time with dedicated skill,
the wall that had been assembled—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...It's so very beautiful.
Side by side with Believe... with a calm heart, I gazed upon the stone walls.

"Though weathered by the wind and cracked in places,
the stones stand resolute and steadfast.
A silent vessel, holding within it unyielding skill."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. All right—
choice_data_list: You're all fired up now, Believe.
You're all fired up now, Believe.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (...Let's go home. Together with Trainer.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (Tomorrow too. Because our work is waiting for us.)

And—the day of the Sprinters Stakes
has finally arrived.

text_block_list.name: Believe
choice_data_list: Are you sure you don't have anything to tell me?
Are you sure there's nothing you want to tell me?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"We don't really have anything emotional to talk about,"
apparently. Neither of them. ...Nor me.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
So, all that's left now...
is to run and settle it.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Today, I will do the best work I can.
By running faster than anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: This conviction is the one thing I will never bend—and I won't let anyone else bend it either!
choice_data_list: Yeah. Keep pushing straight through, Believe!
Yeah. Stay true to yourself, Believe!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Yes... Without fail!
